name: urefy-monorepo
description: UREfy - Private Communication and Knowledge Workspace

scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=packages/core-crypto && npm run build --workspace=packages/vault-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server-edge && npm run build --workspace=packages/daemon-archivist && npm run build --workspace=packages/client-ui
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:branding
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit --project packages/server-edge/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/daemon-archivist/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/client-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/client-ui/functions/tsconfig.json
